# Lab 07 hints

<details><summary>Hint 1 — Count events, not implications</summary>

A `tool_rejected` event does not necessarily mean the run failed. Count its occurrence without inferring a terminal outcome.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 2 — Truthy is not the same as true</summary>

The string `"false"` is truthy in Python. For replay hits, require `replayed is True`.

</details>

<details><summary>Hint 3 — Guard on event kind</summary>

Count replay hits only on `tool_result` events. Use `.get()` for optional fields so unrelated events do not raise exceptions.

</details>
